subject: Maths
prompt: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Pythagoras' theorem Diagram</title>
  <style>
    .background { fill:#ffffff; }
    .triangle { fill:none; stroke:#1d4ed8; stroke-width:4; }
    .side-label { font-family:sans-serif; font-size:24px; fill:#1f2937; }
    .formula { font-family:sans-serif; font-size:28px; font-weight:bold; fill:#1f2937; }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { fill:#1f2937; }
      50% { fill:#ff6b6b; }
      100% { fill:#1f2937; }
    }
    .formula { animation:pulse 2s infinite; }
  </style>
  <rect class="background" x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600"/>
  <!-- Right-angled triangle -->
  <polygon class="triangle" points="200,400 400,400 200,250"/>
  <!-- Side labels -->
  <text class="side-label" x="300" y="430">a</text>
  <text class="side-label" x="160" y="330">b</text>
  <text class="side-label" x="280" y="350">c</text>
  <!-- Formula -->
  <text class="formula" x="350" y="520">a² + b² = c²</text>
</svg>

subject: Maths
prompt: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Parts of a circle Diagram</title>
  
  <!-- Circle -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="300" r="200" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Radius line with animation -->
  <line id="radius" x1="400" y1="300" x2="400" y2="300" stroke="#4A90E2" stroke-width="2">
    <animate
      attributeName="x2"
      values="400;600"
      dur="2s"
      repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate
      attributeName="y2"
      values="300;300"
      dur="2s"
      repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <text x="500" y="290" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#4A90E2" text-anchor="middle">Radius</text>
  
  <!-- Diameter line -->
  <line x1="200" y1="300" x2="600" y2="300" stroke="#E94E77" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
  <text x="400" y="320" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#E94E77" text-anchor="middle">Diameter</text>
  
  <!-- Circumference label -->
  <text x="400" y="520" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#333333" text-anchor="middle">Circumference</text>
  
  <!-- Center label -->
  <text x="400" y="310" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Center</text>
</svg>

subject: Physics
prompt: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Series circuit Diagram</title>
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Battery -->
  <rect x="120" y="200" width="60" height="200" fill="#f0e68c" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="200" x2="140" y2="170" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="6"/>
  <line x1="160" y1="200" x2="160" y2="170" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="6"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="400" x2="140" y2="430" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="6"/>
  <line x1="160" y1="400" x2="160" y2="430" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="6"/>
  <text x="140" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Battery</text>

  <!-- Switch -->
  <rect x="260" y="250" width="20" height="100" fill="#d3d3d3" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="270" cy="260" r="8" fill="#ff0000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="270" y="240" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Switch</text>

  <!-- Bulb 1 -->
  <circle cx="360" cy="300" r="30" fill="#fffacd" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text x="360" y="310" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Bulb 1</text>

  <!-- Bulb 2 -->
  <circle cx="520" cy="300" r="30" fill="#fffacd" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text x="520" y="310" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Bulb 2</text>

  <!-- Wiring -->
  <line x1="180" y1="300" x2="260" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="280" y1="300" x2="330" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="390" y1="300" x2="510" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="540" y1="300" x2="580" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="580" y1="300" x2="580" y2="200" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="580" y1="200" x2="180" y2="200" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- Arrow marker -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="0" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L10,3.5 z" fill="#000000"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Animated electron -->
  <circle id="electron" cx="190" cy="300" r="5" fill="#1e90ff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <animate
    attributeName="cx"
    from="190"
    to="580"
    dur="4s"
    repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <animate
    attributeName="cy"
    from="300"
    to="300"
    dur="4s"
    repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <!-- Current direction text -->
  <text x="400" y="570" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">
    Conventional current flows from positive to negative
  </text>

  <!-- Educational explanation -->
  <text x="400" y="50" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">
    In a series circuit, the current is the same everywhere
  </text>

  <!-- Voltage labels -->
  <text x="130" y="370" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Cell Voltage (V)</text>
  <text x="360" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">V₁</text>
  <text x="520" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">V₂</text>
</svg>

subject: Biology
prompt: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Photosynthesis Diagram</title>
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#f8fafc"/>

  <!-- Definitions -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="#555" />
    </marker>
    <!-- Sunlight ray animation -->
    <animateTransform
      id="rayAnim"
      attributeName="transform"
      type="translate"
      dur="2s"
      repeatCount="indefinite"
      values="0,0; 0,5; 0,0"
      keyTimes="0;0.5;1" />
  </defs>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="760" height="560" fill="none" />
  <g id="sun">
    <polygon points="400,60 420,120 380,120" fill="#ffeb3b"/>
    <g fill="#ffeb3b">
      <rect x="394" y="60" width="12" height="20" />
      <rect x="404" y="60" width="12" height="20" />
      <rect x="394" y="80" width="12" height="20" />
      <rect x="404" y="80" width="12" height="20" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Sunlight rays -->
  <g fill="#ffeb3b" filter="blur(1px)">
    <rect x="390" y="120" width="20" height="60" rx="10" ry="10" />
    <rect x="410" y="120" width="20" height="60" rx="10" ry="10">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="0,0; 0,5; 0,0" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" />
    </rect>
    <rect x="430" y="120" width="20" height="60" rx="10" ry="10" />
  </g>

  <!-- Plant trunk -->
  <rect x="380" y="300" width="40" height="140" fill="#8d5524"/>

  <!-- Roots -->
  <rect x="360" y="460" width="80" height="20" fill="#8d5524"/>
  <text x="400" y="450" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">Roots absorb water</text>

  <!-- Leaves -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="200" rx="80" ry="30" fill="#4caf50"/>
  <text x="400" y="190" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff">Leaf</text>

  <!-- Chloroplasts -->
  <g fill="#33691e" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1">
    <circle cx="360" cy="200" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="380" cy="190" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="210" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="420" cy="190" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="440" cy="210" r="8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Glucose -->
  <text x="400" y="260" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">Glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆)</text>

  <!-- CO₂ arrows entering leaf -->
  <line x1="320" y1="260" x2="320" y2="180" stroke="#ff6f00" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <animate attributeName="y2" values="260;200" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <text x="310" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#ff6f00" text-anchor="end">CO₂</text>

  <!-- Water arrows entering root -->
  <line x1="400" y1="460" x2="400" y2="540" stroke="#2196f3" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <animate attributeName="y1" values="460;520" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <text x="410" y="520" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#2196f3" text-anchor="start">H₂O</text>

  <!-- O₂ arrows exiting leaf -->
  <line x1="460" y1="260" x2="460" y2="180" stroke="#4caf50" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <animate attributeName="y2" values="260;200" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <text x="470" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#4caf50" text-anchor="start">O₂</text>

  <!-- Balanced equation -->
  <text x="400" y="580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">
    6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂
  </text>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="120" y="140" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Sunlight provides energy</text>
  <text x="120" y="170" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Chlorophyll captures light</text>
  <text x="120" y="200" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Plants produce glucose and oxygen</text>
</svg>

subject: Chemistry
prompt: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
<title>States of Matter Diagram</title>
<style>
  .bg{fill:#f8fafc;}
  .section{fill:none;stroke:#4b5563;stroke-width:2;}
  .label{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:18px;fill:#111827;}
  .solid-dot{fill:#1d4ed8;}
  .liquid-dot{fill:#10b981;}
  .gas-dot{fill:#f59e0b;}
  .transition-arrow{stroke:#9ca3af;stroke-width:2;fill:none;marker-end:url(#arrow);}
  @keyframes vibrate{0%{transform:translate(0,0);}50%{transform:translate(2,0);}100%{transform:translate(0,0);}}
  .solid-dot{animation:vibrate 0.5s infinite;}
</style>
<defs>
  <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
    <path d="M0,0 L10,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="#9ca3af"/>
  </marker>
</defs>
<rect class="bg" width="800" height="600"/>
<rect x="40" y="40" width="200" height="480" class="section"/>
<rect x="280" y="40" width="200" height="480" class="section"/>
<rect x="520" y="40" width="200" height="480" class="section"/>
<text x="140" y="30" class="label" text-anchor="middle">SOLID</text>
<text x="380" y="30" class="label" text-anchor="middle">LIQUID</text>
<text x="620" y="30" class="label" text-anchor="middle">GAS</text>
<!-- Solid particles -->
<g transform="translate(60,100)">
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="0" cy="0"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="20" cy="0"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="40" cy="0"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="10" cy="20"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="30" cy="20"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="50" cy="20"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="20" cy="40"/>
  <circle class="solid-dot" r="4" cx="40" cy="40"/>
</g>
<!-- Liquid particles -->
<g transform="translate(320,100)">
  <circle class="liquid-dot" r="4" cx="0" cy="0">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath d="M0 0 L20 0 L20 20 L0 20 Z M20 20 L40 20 L40 40 L20 40 Z M40 40 L60 40 L60 60 L40 60 Z"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle class="liquid-dot" r="4" cx="30" cy="0">
    <animateMotion dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath d="M30 0 L50 0 L50 20 L30 20 Z M50 20 L70 20 L70 40 L50 40 Z M70 40 L90 40 L90 60 L70 60 Z"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle class="liquid-dot" r="4" cx="60" cy="0">
    <animateMotion dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath d="M60 0 L80 0 L80 20 L60 20 Z M80 20 L100 20 L100 40 L80 40 Z M100 40 L120 40 L120 60 L100 60 Z"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
</g>
<!-- Gas particles -->
<g transform="translate(580,100)">
  <circle class="gas-dot" r="3" cx="0" cy="0">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 120 0; 120 -120; 0 -120; 0 0" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle class="gas-dot" r="3" cx="30" cy="0">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; -120 0; -120 120; 0 120; 0 0" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle class="gas-dot" r="3" cx="60" cy="0">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 60 0; 60 60; 0 60; 0 0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle class="gas-dot" r="3" cx="90" cy="0">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; -60 0; -60 -60; 0 -60; 0 0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
</g>
<!-- Transitions -->
<path class="transition-arrow" d="M240,220 L260,220"/>
<text x="200" y="215" class="label" font-size="14">Melting</text>
<path class="transition-arrow" d="M240,380 L260,380"/>
<text x="200" y="375" class="label" font-size="14">Freezing</text>
<path class="transition-arrow" d="M480,220 L500,220"/>
<text x="440" y="215" class="label" font-size="14">Evaporation</text>
<path class="transition-arrow" d="M480,380 L500,380"/>
<text x="440" y="375" class="label" font-size="14">Condensation</text>
<!-- Explanation text -->
<text x="140" y="520" class="label" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">
Particles vibrate in place in a solid.
</text>
<text x="380" y="520" class="label" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">
Particles move past each other in a liquid.
</text>
<text x="620" y="520" class="label" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">
Particles move freely and rapidly in a gas.
</text>
</svg>
